findings.claim: Decoded terminal learning labels are unavailable (decoded_terminal_learning_labels_available=false); lineage_support records terminal metadata at terminal_score_time 0.99/terminal_state_time 1.0 outside the learning window [0.0,0.5]. Therefore last-record joint-head credit cannot be presented as final affinity benefit; the immediate-selection-versus-descendant-quality comparison is unavailable.

Immediate selection evidence (endpoint_effects) and descendant survival credit disagree in direction for several features: e.g. landmark_00_occupancy3 has endpoint_effects:15 integrated z +0.545 (q=0.00024) and survival_effects:0 +0.365 (q=0.120); landmark_07_soft_mass endpoint_effects:37 +0.374 vs survival_effects:70 +0.220; landmark_10_soft_mass endpoint_effects:46 +0.146 vs survival_effects:100 +0.234; landmark_18_local_czz endpoint_effects:68 +0.264 vs survival_effects:186 +0.217. Pair kernels 1.5/2.5 (endpoint_effects:9,10) are strongly positive at endpoint but have no matching survival credit. This disagreement should lower direction priority for features whose endpoint signal is not echoed in survival credit.

Ancestral coverage is thin: lineage_support reports 349 nodes with fewer than 3 ancestors and 531 with fewer than 6 ancestors out of 700 batch nodes, and multiple testing is BH jointly over 400 survival field/measure tests. Survival enrichment z values are small (e.g. 0.365, 0.220, 0.234) with q values 0.12-0.30, so survivor bias and low ancestral coverage limit any survival-based prioritization.

Multiplicity-adjusted support ranks pair_kernel_1.5 and pair_kernel_2.5 highest: adjusted_covariance q=0.081/0.077 (branch_adjusted:86,87), adjusted_correlation q=0.019/0.046 (branch_adjusted:240,241), raw_correlation q=0.027/0.041 (branch_adjusted:163,164), raw_covariance q=0.134/0.116 (branch_adjusted:9,10). A priority decision that differs from ranking point estimates alone: pair_kernel_3.5 has a larger raw_covariance mean (7.45e-07 vs 8.70e-07 for 1.5) but weaker adjusted support (q=0.515), so it should be ranked below 1.5/2.5.

Independent-batch agreement is strongest for joint_innovation_RMS_A and joint_internal_RMS_A: raw_correlation q=9.3e-05/1.5e-04 with same_sign_batch_fraction 1.0 (branch_adjusted:228,230) and adjusted_correlation q=2.8e-04/9.7e-04 with same_sign_batch_fraction 0.93/1.0 (branch_adjusted:305,307). These are negative (whole_window_mean -0.142/-0.130 raw; -0.150/-0.137 adjusted). A counterexample that would weaken a proposed direction: if a batch showed positive joint_innovation_RMS_A correlation, the negative direction would not be reproducible; the supplied data show 1.0 same-sign batch fraction, so no such counterexample is present.

shape_yy is the only shape component with consistent negative adjusted support: raw_correlation q=0.0026 with same_sign_batch_fraction 1.0 (branch_adjusted:158), adjusted_correlation q=0.015 with same_sign_batch_fraction 1.0 (branch_adjusted:235), adjusted_covariance q=0.131 (branch_adjusted:81), raw_covariance q=0.153 (branch_adjusted:4). Other shape components (xx, zz, xy, xz, yz) have q>0.13 and mixed batch signs, so shape_yy is the only shape direction with reproducible batch agreement.

Local coordinate information beyond global pose: joint_innovation_RMS_A and joint_internal_RMS_A (branch_adjusted:151,153,74,76) capture internal motion after removing translation, while joint_translation_RMS_A (branch_adjusted:152,75) is weaker (q=0.072/0.095). joint_diagnostics:1 (innovation_native_alignment, q=2.2e-09) and joint_diagnostics:11 (teacher_innovation_contrast_alignment, q=2.2e-09) confirm that innovation beyond common motion carries information. The extent that should retain freedom is the internal/innovation component; global translation should not be prioritized.

Continuous contrast functions for landmark_00 across the complete observed support [0.0,0.49] show sign changes and rate changes: landmark_00_soft_mass (continuous:0) has first_rate_z 9.27 and last_rate_z -10.00 with 4 sign changes and 1 strong sign conflict; landmark_00_local_dx (continuous:1) has first_rate_z -17.49 and last_rate_z 8.11 with 6 sign changes and 9 strong sign conflicts; landmark_00_local_dy (continuous:2) has first_rate_z -72.37 and last_rate_z 5.52 with 6 sign changes and 4 strong sign conflicts. A constant rule is not supported; a time-conditioned rule is supported by the observed-node interpolation, but polynomial fits are not accepted (polynomial_accepted=false) and extrapolation is not allowed.

Curve fidelity is poor: relative_node_RMSE for landmark_00 features ranges 0.286-0.995 (continuous:0-9), and curve_support reports relative_node_rmse 0.386-0.931 with quiet_node_large_fit_fraction 0.08-0.34 and strong_sign_conflict_nodes 0-15 for the selected features. The contrast curve is not an absolute reward target (not_absolute_target=true), and the poor fit fidelity limits its use as a validated time-conditioned rule.

Population-contrast changes versus parent-child increment contrasts: turnover:1 (landmark_00_soft_mass edge_rate) is +4.55 with p=0.034, while turnover:2 (turnover_residual_rate) is -4.36 with p=0.034; turnover:14 (landmark_00_local_cxx turnover_residual_rate) is +4.29 with p=0.002; turnover:17 (landmark_00_local_cyy turnover_residual_rate) is +5.05 with p=0.0015; turnover:47 (landmark_01_local_cyy turnover_residual_rate) is +6.40 with p=0.0004; turnover:134 (landmark_04_local_cxx turnover_residual_rate) is +5.67 with p=2.5e-05; turnover:224 (landmark_07_local_cxx turnover_residual_rate) is +5.08 with p=0.0001; turnover:254 (landmark_08_local_cxx turnover_residual_rate) is +5.54 with p=0.0001; turnover:497 (landmark_16_local_cyy turnover_residual_rate) is +6.37 with p=0.0001; turnover:584 (landmark_19_local_cxx turnover_residual_rate) is +5.30 with p=0.0002. The turnover residual is an accounting diagnostic, not a causal selection effect or atom velocity; the evidence supports changing cohort composition (reclassification and parent weighting) rather than within-path change alone.

Parent-child increment contrasts: increment_effects:14 (landmark_00_softmin) success_failure_integrated_rate_z -4.91 with q=0.046; increment_effects:15 (landmark_00_occupancy3) +4.28 with q=0.081; increment_effects:10 (pair_kernel_2.5) +3.96 with q=0.208; increment_effects:13 (pair_kernel_7.0) -3.14 with q=0.208; increment_effects:3 (shape_xx) -3.70 with q=0.095; increment_effects:4 (shape_yy) -3.85 with q=0.161. These increment contrasts are weaker and less multiplicity-robust than the endpoint effects, consistent with the turnover accounting showing cohort composition change rather than a strong within-path increment.

Regional enrichment: landmark_00_soft_mass (regional_effects:0) enrichment_z +0.639 q=0.00019; landmark_02_local_dy (regional_effects:22) +0.405 q=0.00013; landmark_06_local_dy (regional_effects:62) +0.425 q=0.00011; landmark_09_local_dy (regional_effects:92) +0.325 q=0.00048; landmark_10_soft_mass (regional_effects:100) +0.395 q=0.00037; landmark_14_local_dy (regional_effects:142) +0.350 q=0.00020; landmark_18_local_dy (regional_effects:182) +0.425 q=0.00043. Parent-edge contrast rates are large for landmark_00_local_cxx (regional_effects:404, -4.34 q=0.029) and landmark_00_local_cyy (regional_effects:405, -4.79 q=0.036), and landmark_00_soft_mass (regional_effects:400, +4.55 q=0.112). These are coordinate enrichment diagnostics, not physical interaction energies or neural-module causation.

hypotheses.claim: Hypothesis: pair-distance shell density at 1.5-2.5 A is the most reproducible coordinate direction, supported by adjusted_covariance q=0.081/0.077, adjusted_correlation q=0.019/0.046, and endpoint_effects:9-12 (pair_kernel_1.5-5.0) all positive with q<0.004. Testable coordinate intervention: observable = pair_kernel_1.5/2.5; intended response = increase in pair_kernel_1.5/2.5; target origin = landmark regions with high soft_mass; spatial scale = 1.5-2.5 A pair distance; discriminating failure condition = no increase in pair_kernel_1.5/2.5 or a decrease in pair_kernel_7.0. The permitted reward recipe that could express this is the pointcloud endpoint reward with teacher_neighbors and pointcloud_delta_A; the pair-kernel term itself is diagnostic only and is not in the executing pointcloud scalar.

Hypothesis: reducing joint_innovation_RMS_A and joint_internal_RMS_A (negative adjusted correlation, same_sign_batch_fraction 0.93-1.0) is a reproducible internal-motion direction. Testable coordinate intervention: observable = joint_innovation_RMS_A and joint_internal_RMS_A; intended response = decrease in both; target origin = internal/innovation component after removing global translation; spatial scale = whole-window internal RMS in A; discriminating failure condition = no decrease or an increase in joint_translation_RMS_A. The permitted reward recipe is the endpoint pointcloud reward with the FLOWR endpoint VJP; the joint diagnostics are not a separate reward term.

Hypothesis: a time-conditioned regional attention rule using validated absolute contrast changes at actual score nodes is supported for landmark_00 features, but the poor curve fidelity (relative_node_RMSE 0.286-0.995, strong_sign_conflict_nodes up to 15) and the prohibition on extrapolation and arbitrary time bins limit it to observed-node interpolation within [0.0,0.49]. Testable coordinate intervention: observable = landmark_00_soft_mass and landmark_00_local_dx/dy; intended response = time-conditioned change in regional attention; target origin = landmark_00 region; temporal scale = observed score times 0.0-0.49; discriminating failure condition = sign conflict at a node or fit RMSE above the curve_support threshold. The permitted reward recipe is the temporal_teacher blend with validated contrast functions; the contrast curve is not an absolute reward target.

Hypothesis: the large turnover residual rates (e.g. +4.29 to +6.40) with matching edge rates indicate changing cohort composition (reclassification and parent weighting) rather than within-path change. Testable coordinate intervention: observable = turnover_residual_rate and edge_rate; intended response = reduction in turnover residual; target origin = parent-child increment contrasts; temporal scale = whole-window rate; discriminating failure condition = turnover residual remaining large while increment contrasts are null. The residual is an accounting diagnostic, not a causal selection effect or atom velocity, so this remains descriptive unless a permitted reward recipe can express it.

Hypothesis: shape_yy is a reproducible negative shape direction (raw_correlation q=0.0026, adjusted_correlation q=0.015, both same_sign_batch_fraction 1.0; endpoint_effects:4 shape_yy integrated z -0.513 q=1.5e-05). Testable coordinate intervention: observable = shape_yy; intended response = decrease in shape_yy; target origin = global shape covariance; spatial scale = A^2; discriminating failure condition = no decrease or an increase in shape_xx/zz. The permitted reward recipe is the endpoint pointcloud reward; shape moments are diagnostic only and are not in the executing pointcloud scalar.

Hypothesis: the compressed-choice teacher alignment (information_audit compressed_choice_excess_fixed_RMS_A 0.081, top4_teacher_overlap 0.470, compressed_chosen_teacher_score_correlation 0.102) and the negative joint_diagnostics:2 (observed_child_score_gain, -0.036, q=1.8e-07) indicate that teacher alignment does not translate into observed child score gain. Testable coordinate intervention: observable = teacher_innovation_contrast_alignment and observed_child_score_gain; intended response = positive observed child score gain; target origin = teacher contrast internal fraction (joint_diagnostics:14, 0.787); spatial scale = whole-window; discriminating failure condition = teacher alignment increasing while observed child score gain remains negative. This remains descriptive because the teacher score correlations are observational and not a fitted or independently validated affinity predictor.

limitations: Descendant credit is recorded joint-head credit, not decoded terminal affinity; decoded_terminal_learning_labels_available=false.
Turnover residual includes score reclassification and extant-parent weighting, not only resampling.
Adjusted branch covariance is supplied evidence; region moments themselves are not rigid-motion residuals.
Curve fitting does not establish causal benefit or a gradient; no time bins or outside-window analysis.
Static teachers are last-learning-node forecasts, not actual final structures.
All weak and null scalar effects retained; current study outcomes are withheld from design roles.
Pair kernels, moment effects and turnover rates are diagnostic evidence only; the executing pointcloud scalar has no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term.
Temperatures are immutable task parameters; no temperature edit is proposed.
